svg.aria-label: The niche of Gerver's sofa (orange) as the union of the quadrants Q⁻(s): grey segments show the inner walls b(s) and d(s) from x(s) down to the x-axis for many s, one quadrant is shaded darker, and the curves D, x and B bound the union from above: x is traced by the corners, D and B are the envelopes of the walls
